execution_policy.convergence: One bounded derivation, one implementation pass, one adversarial review and at most one repair pass, then decide PASS_SCOPED, FAIL or BLOCKED.
execution_policy.mutation: Branch-only under R48. No merge or protected-branch mutation without separate authorization.
execution_policy.data: Raw maps, catalogues and chains remain outside Git.
execution_policy.agents: Subagent/native delegation is NOT_RUN unless an execution tool actually launches and returns a receipt.
execution_policy.claims: No observed discovery, calibrated significance, Bianchi family identification or global-tilt claim before relevant gates pass.
